title: Why AI Governance Frameworks Are Hard to Adopt: A Role-Based Stress Test of the NIST AI RMF
abstract: arXiv:2608.12352v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI governance frameworks can be known, used, and implemented in form without becoming governance in practice. This paper examines that problem through a role-based stress test of the NIST Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF) in consumer lending. We treat framework adoption as a governance translation problem: whether RMF language can become role-usable, cross-level, authority-connected governance over the AI system-in-use, rather than producing governance-looking artifacts.   The study uses LLM-based role simulation as a structured analytic probe. We apply a 4 $\times$ 2 $\times$ 3 design across four organizational roles, two AI deployments, and three governance hard cases, producing 120 scored responses. Results show that local translation was not the main problem. Simulated actors generally understood their assigned roles and translated the RMF into local activity. translated_title: 为什么AI治理框架难以采纳：基于角色的NIST AI RMF压力测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12352v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：AI治理框架可能在形式上被知晓、使用和实施，但并未在实践中成为真正的治理。本文通过基于角色的NIST人工智能风险管理框架（AI RMF）在消费贷款领域的压力测试来探讨这一问题。我们将框架采纳视为一个治理翻译问题：即RMF的语言能否转化为角色可用、跨层级、与权威相连的针对实际使用中AI系统的治理，而非产生仅具治理外观的产物。研究采用基于LLM的角色模拟作为结构化分析探针。我们应用了一个4×2×3的设计，涵盖四个组织角色、两种AI部署场景和三个治理难点案例，生成了120个评分响应。结果表明，局部翻译并非主要问题。模拟参与者通常理解其分配的角色，并将RMF转化为局部活动。更困难的问题在于这些活动能否……
tldr: 本研究通过角色压力测试发现，AI治理框架（如NIST AI RMF）采纳的主要障碍不是局部理解不足，而是跨层级、权威相连的治理实施难以实现，导致框架仅停留在形式层面。
en_tdlr: This study, through role-based stress testing, reveals that the main barrier to adopting AI governance frameworks (e.g., NIST AI RMF) is not local understanding but the difficulty of implementing cross-level, authority-connected governance, leaving frameworks at a formalistic level.
